subject: Brightline vendor enrollment & Peppol invoice mapping
messages:
From: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@brightline.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: AP Team <ap-team@brightline.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Vendor registration + Peppol/e-invoice mapping for upcoming PO

Hi Vivek,

We have a PO coming through from our procurement team for the Q2 integration work (PO will be raised next week). Before that lands in our system, AP needs Redwood set up as a vendor in Brightline so invoices route properly. Can you confirm the following and send the AP onboarding packet?

- Legal name and registered remit-to name for bank mandate (exact text required)
- Preferred remit currency and whether Redwood can accept split-currency invoices if a PO spans GBP/EUR
- VAT treatment: we have a UK-based GL where some lines may be reverse-charge — do you provide the reverse-charge wording or do we need to self-bill?
- Peppol/Peppol participant ID and whether you accept Peppol e-invoices (we can test via our staging gateway)
- Required PO fields to match on invoice for automated matching (we require PO#, PO line#, cost center/GL code field)

Attached: our vendor intake form (blank) so you can provide bank details and tax evidence. We also included our Peppol receiver spec for your mapping team.

Quick timeline: procurement wants Redwood mirrored in our vendor portal by 2027-04-09 so AP can accept the PO. Can you confirm next steps by EOD Monday?

Thanks,
Sara Hayes
Head of Procurement Operations
Brightline Media

[Attachment: brightline_vendor_intake_form.pdf (PDF)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@brightline.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 12:10:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + Peppol/e-invoice mapping for upcoming PO

Sara — thanks for the clear list. Putting this together now and looping in Laura (tax/evidence) and Karthik (AP field mapping). High level: we do support Peppol e-invoicing and can participate in a staging test. We do not typically self-bill by default; we can enable self-billing with a signed agreement, but for UK reverse-charge we typically expect the supplier invoice to contain the reverse charge statement.

Attached to this reply: Redwood vendor onboarding packet (required fields and bank mandate instructions) and a Peppol field map that shows the XML elements we populate and where to surface PO line-level GL code. That should make mapping straightforward on your side.

Action items from Redwood: 
- We will return a completed vendor form (with legal name and remit details) + copy of EU VAT certificate or W-9/W-8 as applicable.
- Karthik will prepare a short PO-to-invoice field map (PO# -> invoice:InvoiceReference, PO line# -> InvoiceLine/OrderLineReference, Cost center -> InvoiceLine/AccountingCostCentre).
- We can run a Peppol test on staging; please share your test endpoint and participant ID.

Can you confirm whether Brightline requires a separate GL code per invoice line or if a single header-level GL is acceptable when PO lines map to different cost centers? Our default is line-level but we can support header-level with explicit line tags.

Next steps: I’ll send our completed vendor packet by Monday morning.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Finance Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_packet.pdf, peppol_field_map.xlsx]

From: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@brightline.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: AP Team <ap-team@brightline.com>, Peter Molnar <peter.molnar@brightline.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 08:45:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + Peppol/e-invoice mapping for upcoming PO

Thanks Vivek — attached is our completed intake form (filled by procurement). A few clarifying points from AP: 

- We can accept either line-level GL or header-level as long as the GL mapping is provided in the invoice XML; for automated posting we prefer line-level.
- Brightline will apply reverse-charge on UK services when supplier is non-UK established and the service falls under reverse-charge scope. If Redwood is established in the UK and charges VAT, we will not apply reverse-charge. If you do not charge VAT, our AP will post the reverse-charge entry — but we require the invoice to state why reverse-charge was applied (e.g., “Reverse charge: VAT to be accounted for by the recipient under Article 194”).
- Peppol participant ID (staging): 98765:brightline-staging. Production ID to follow.

Attaching: brightline_vendor_form_filled.pdf. We’ll also need a bank mandate PDF and either an EU VAT cert or a completed W-9/W-8 depending on entity.

Can you send a sample Peppol XML with Redwood’s mappings and a sample PDF invoice that contains PO line references so our matching team can validate?

Best,
Sara

[Attachment: brightline_vendor_form_filled.pdf]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 10:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + Peppol/e-invoice mapping for upcoming PO

Sara — thanks, received the completed form. A few concrete items and next steps below.

Summary of what we attached/are sending: 
- Completed vendor packet (PDF) with legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc. / Remit-to: Redwood Inference Ltd (for UK/EU invoices) 
- Bank mandate stub: see section 4 of the onboarding packet (we will upload signed mandate once doc signed by our bank).
- Tax evidence: Laura attached a copy of Redwood Inference Ltd VAT registration (GB123456789) where applicable; for US invoices we will supply a W-9 on request.
- Peppol test: Karthik has prepared a sample Peppol XML and a PDF invoice exported from our staging system. We’ll upload both to the Drive folder and share the link below. Test files include PO# and PO line numbers in InvoiceReference/OrderLineReference.

UK reverse-charge guidance: to make matching and accounting simple for Brightline, include the following on the invoice when reverse-charge applies: 
  - Line item VAT amount = 0.00
  - Invoice note: "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient (see Article 194)"
  - Include supplier VAT number and the recipient legal entity/GL reference if provided.

Multi-currency: we can accept multi-currency invoices but each invoice must clearly state the currency per line; our system prefers a single invoice currency. If a PO spans currencies we recommend one invoice per currency to avoid FX posting issues.

Next actions (for both teams):
- Brightline: provide production Peppol participant ID and test endpoint (you gave staging ID).
- Brightline: post a staging test invoice to the provided Drive link by Friday so we can validate mapping.
- Redwood: we will push the Peppol XML + sample PDF to Drive and share the link. Karthik will follow up with a one-page PO->invoice mapping doc.

Drive test folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2Bv-Peppol-Test-Env
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2048/DL-2027-0842

If this looks good I’ll mark the vendor as ready-to-onboard and coordinate with Marcus on invoice acceptance rules.

Thanks — Vivek

Redwood Inference
